name: Palazzo cafe bar
description: All-day café right on Kitroplatia beach, serving generous breakfasts with your feet almost in the sand and a wide view of the bay. Arrive before 10:00 in summer to get a front-row table.

name: Deja Vu
description: Friendly family café on Kitroplatia with one of the biggest breakfast menus in town, from Cretan omelettes to pancakes, and tables facing the sea. Easy walk from the harbour; busy on summer mornings.
address: Akti Papa Nikolaou Pagalou 11, Ag. Nikolaos 721 00, Greece

name: blé stiló
description: Small micro-bakery in Agios Nikolaos baking wholesome, sugar-free breakfasts and pastries from natural ingredients. Ideal for a light, healthy start; seating is limited, so take away if it is full.
address: Akti Nearchou kai, Kapetan Tavla 12, Ag. Nikolaos 721 00, Greece

name: Zygos Urban Garden
description: Popular garden café overlooking Lake Voulismeni, loved for its brunch plates and good coffee in a leafy setting. Weekend mornings get busy, so come early.

name: To Votsalo
description: Relaxed seaside café a short walk out of the centre, perfect for a breakfast followed by a swim off the rocks. Quieter than the town-centre cafés, with sea views from every table.

name: Cremma coffee house
description: Coffee house famous for its Thessaloniki-style bougatsa, flaky and warm with cream or cheese, plus excellent coffee. A quick, inexpensive breakfast stop in the town centre.

name: Veráno Cafe Bar Elounda
description: All-day café in Elounda serving brunch, sweet and savoury crêpes and well-made coffee. Handy before a boat trip from the nearby harbour.
address: Pl. Sfakianaki Mpoti, Schisma Elountas 720 53, Greece

name: Clock coffee & brunch
description: Coffee and brunch spot that many call the best coffee in Elounda, with fresh pastries and filling sandwiches. Small and popular, so expect a short wait at peak times.

name: Epico
description: Breakfast café in Plaka with a terrace looking straight across to Spinalonga island. A lovely start before taking the short boat ride to the fortress.

name: Square cafe and brunch
description: Brunch café on the upper square of Kritsa village, with homemade plates and views over the rooftops and olive groves. Combine it with a stroll through the village lanes and the Panagia Kera church.

name: Smile Cafe
description: Café in Istron with a terrace overlooking olive groves down to Mirabello Bay, good for an easy breakfast and coffee. Free parking and a calm setting away from the main road.

name: calma freshly baked stories
description: Artisan bakery in Neapoli turning out freshly baked bread, pies and pastries every morning. Grab breakfast to go before heading up to the Lasithi Plateau.

name: the neighbourhood bakery cafe
description: Village bakery in Sisi known for its cheese pies, flaky pastries and coffee. A cheap, quick breakfast on the way to the harbour or beach.

name: Casablanca
description: Breakfast café in one of Ierapetra's oldest neoclassical buildings on the pedestrian street, with a full breakfast menu and good coffee. A stylish, central start to the day.

name: Kornaros
description: Ierapetra bakery known for its kalitsounia (sweet cheese pastries), fresh pies and homemade ice cream. Perfect for a quick breakfast or an afternoon treat.

name: Take a Break
description: Seaside café in Pachia Ammos serving breakfast with local traditional products right by the water. A relaxed stop on the coastal road between Agios Nikolaos and Ierapetra.

name: Koupa Café
description: Beachfront café in Pachia Ammos known for its waffles and coffee, with tables just above the sand. Great for a late breakfast before a swim.

name: Kritika Edesmata (Kavousi)
description: Village bakery in Kavousi famous for fried myzithra cheese pies and sourdough rusks. Stock up for a picnic before visiting the ancient olive tree of Azoria.

name: Delogo
description: Morning favourite in Makrygialos for good coffee and freshly made sandwiches. A simple, friendly local spot a short walk from the beach.

name: Café Livyko
description: Traditional little kafeneio in Myrtos, the go-to place for an early breakfast with Greek coffee and simple homemade bites. Opens early, ideal before the day gets hot.

name: To Tsoureki
description: Family bakery-patisserie in Sitia since 1970, known for its tsoureki, traditional sweets and fresh pies. A classic local stop for breakfast or edible souvenirs.

name: ARC Espresso & Cocktail Bar
description: Espresso and cocktail bar with a panoramic terrace over Agios Nikolaos, serving specialty coffee and homemade cakes by day. The view is best in the late afternoon.

name: cafe Du Lac bar
description: Landmark café on the edge of Lake Voulismeni since 1992, a classic place to sit over coffee and watch the town go by. Prime lakeside tables fill up in the evening.

name: Peripou Coffeehouse & Live Music Bar
description: Coffee roastery and café that becomes a live-music bar in the evening, serving freshly roasted coffee in a cosy space. Check their schedule for live nights.

name: Blend Coffee Shop
description: Specialty coffee shop in Elounda with carefully brewed coffee and fresh pastries every morning. A good grab-and-go stop before a boat trip.

name: Cielo Delicious Moments
description: Elounda café where people queue for what many call the best coffee in the village, plus sweet and savoury bites. Expect a line on summer mornings; it moves quickly.

name: Arachtopolion
description: Laid-back village café in Kroustas serving homemade sweets and fresh lemonade under the trees. A peaceful stop on the mountain road above Kritsa.

name: Café «To Kentron»
description: Historic kafeneio on Neapoli's main square, the place to try soumada, the local almond drink, with Greek coffee. Sit outside under the trees and watch village life.

name: Kafeneio O Kastelos
description: Village kafeneio in Avrakontes on the Lasithi Plateau, serving strong Greek coffee and homemade pies in the shade of mulberry trees. A genuine taste of plateau life.

name: 90 Moires Coffee Co.
description: Coffee bar in Ierapetra praised for Italian-quality espresso and expertly made coffee. A short stop in the town centre for serious coffee lovers.

name: Kafenion "Chez Georges" (Georgios Mich. Moutsakis)
description: Authentic village kafeneio in Kavousi with Greek coffee, raki and small meze, unchanged for decades. Ideal break on a drive along the Mirabello coast.

name: Oktana Cafe Bar
description: Creative café-bar in Mochlos serving coffee by day and drinks in the evening, with views of the Minoan islet. Pair it with a swim from the village rocks.

name: Tiny Coffee
description: Tiny coffee spot with what many locals call the best coffee in Sitia, brewed with care. Mostly takeaway, with a couple of seats outside.

name: Café Kafé (Konstantinos Mich. Katsamboxakis)
description: Classic café on Sitia's main square with tables right by the sea, ideal for coffee or breakfast. A relaxed, inexpensive local favourite.

name: The Coffee House
description: Little oasis café in remote Xerokampos, serving coffee, juices and light breakfasts to beach-goers. The road is long and winding, so it is a welcome stop on arrival.

name: Mitsakakis
description: Sitia institution for warm loukoumades with honey, creamy galaktoboureko and homemade ice cream, with tables by the waterfront. Busy in the evening, but service is quick.

name: "Aretousa" Sitia Sweet Treats (Garefalakis)
description: Traditional sweets shop in Sitia making handmade kalitsounia and other local specialities. Great for edible souvenirs to take home.

name: Pastry Honey Oil
description: Patisserie in Sitia making traditional Cretan sweets with local honey, olive oil and other regional ingredients. A good stop for gifts or an afternoon treat.

name: Francesco Handmade Premium Gelato & Pastry
description: Premium handmade gelato and Italian-style pastry in Agios Nikolaos, with a much-praised tiramisu. Perfect for a stroll around the lake after dinner.

name: Solo Gelato Agios Nikolaos
description: Gelateria in Agios Nikolaos with a big range of fresh, natural flavours made daily. Open late in summer for an after-dinner treat.

name: LAMPROS – Cheiropoiita Glyka & Almyra
description: Shop in Agios Nikolaos making handmade sweets and savoury pies, from syrupy pastries to cheese pies. Good for breakfast on the go or a sweet souvenir.

name: Liontas Zacharoplasteio
description: Neapoli patisserie famous for its goat-milk ice cream and galaktoboureko, a real local speciality. Worth a detour on the way to or from the Lasithi Plateau.

name: Kritika Edesmata (Cretan Dishes)
description: Family shop in Ierapetra known for the best xerotigana in town, crisp fried pastry spirals with honey, plus other traditional sweets and coffee. Ideal for an authentic Cretan dessert.

name: Zacharoplasteio Chrysofakis Stelios
description: Long-standing patisserie in Ierapetra with some of the best ice cream in the area and classic Greek pastries. Easy to reach in the town centre.

name: Takis kai Voula – Zacharoplastiki
description: Patisserie in Makrygialos famous for its ice cream and baklava, also serving breakfast and coffee. A favourite after-beach treat.
address: Analipsi - Makry Gialos Makry Gialos, Ierapetra 720 55, Greece

name: Artozacharoplasteio Fanourgiakis Dimitrios
description: Old-fashioned village bakery on the Lasithi Plateau baking traditional breads, rusks and sweets as they did decades ago. A charming stop on a plateau drive; opening hours can be irregular, so go in the morning.

name: iScream Frozen Yogurt – Juice Bar – Ice Cream
description: Homemade frozen yogurt, Greek ice cream, fresh juices and smoothies in central Agios Nikolaos. A lighter alternative to classic gelato, a few steps from the harbour.

name: V&V ice cream and coffee
description: Ice cream and coffee in Plaka facing Spinalonga, with goat-milk ice cream and waffles alongside espresso drinks. A perfect stop before or after the boat to the island.

name: Kaimaki
description: A dedicated gelateria in Mirtos village with inventive flavours, crêpes and warm service. The real ice-cream stop on this stretch of the south coast.

name: Honey & Cinamon
description: Small spot for handmade ice cream and desserts on the Elounda waterfront promenade. Try the kataifi with ice cream or the orange cake.

name: Gelato Spot
description: Ice cream shop on Sissi harbour serving soft ice cream, goat-milk scoops, milkshakes and waffles. Take your cone for a stroll along the harbour promenade.

name: Casa Gelato
description: A new gelateria on the Ierapetra seafront promenade with a range of fresh gelato flavours. Good for an evening scoop during a walk along the waterfront.

name: Amalthea The Divine Goat
description: Café at Psychro next to the Dikteon Cave and the Mythology Park, serving coffee, fresh juices, ice cream, pies and goat products. A practical stop for breakfast or a snack before or after the climb to the cave.

name: Taverna Kronio
description: Family-run classic of the Lasithi Plateau in Tzermiado, loved for lamb with artichokes, moussaka and warm hospitality, with views across the plateau fields. Book for lunch on summer weekends and check hours outside high season.

name: Argoulias Tavern
description: Village taverna in Agios Georgios on the Lasithi Plateau cooking home-style dishes with produce from the plateau's own fields. A genuine lunch stop on a plateau drive.

name: TAVERNA PETROS
description: Traditional taverna in Psychro near the Dikteon Cave, with grilled meats, home-cooked stews and views over the Lasithi Plateau. Ideal for lunch after visiting the cave; arrive before the tour groups.

name: Restaurant Tzanakis Michael
description: Taverna at the Seli Ambelou pass by the old stone windmills, with a panoramic view over the whole Lasithi Plateau and hearty Cretan dishes. The mountain road is winding, so allow time and pick a clear day for the view.

name: Oreon Gis / Mountain Land
description: Farm-style Cretan cooking in the plateau village of Pinakiano, using the family's own vegetables, cheeses and meat. A peaceful, rural setting; call ahead outside summer.

name: To Synafi tou Kritsoti
description: Homely Cretan cooking on the Lasithi Plateau, known for spit-roasted meats in a traditional stone setting. Generous portions at fair prices.

name: Traditional Tavern "Dikti"
description: Long-standing taverna on the Lasithi Plateau with consistently strong reviews for traditional dishes such as lamb and slow-cooked stews. A reliable lunch stop on a plateau tour.

name: To Steki tou Peponi
description: Simple village taverna in Mesa Lasithi known for homemade pies and slow-cooked dishes. Authentic and inexpensive, best for an unhurried lunch.
address: Epar.Od. Neapolis - Chersonisou 25, Mesa Lasithi 720 52, Greece

name: Taverna Marianna
description: Small family taverna on the Lasithi Plateau where the owner cooks genuine home-style Cretan food. Few tables, so lunch can be slow on busy days.

name: Taverna Stereos
description: Mountain taverna on the remote Katharo plateau at 1,100 m, serving grilled meats and local cheeses surrounded by peaks. Reached by a long mountain road from Kritsa; open mainly in the warmer months.
address: Katharon Kritsas Mirampellou, Ag. Nikolaos 720 51, Greece

name: Taverna Paradisos Kritsa
description: Cretan-cuisine taverna in Kritsa with traditional dishes and a garden setting, a natural stop after visiting the Panagia Kera church. Park at the village entrance and walk in.

name: Aristidis Cafe
description: Authentic old kafeneio in Kritsa for Greek coffee, raki and small meze plates, little changed in decades. Sit outside and watch village life.

name: Taverna Stavrakakis "O Kroustas"
description: Celebrated village taverna in Kroustas, famous for its grilled meats and traditional cooking in a lively, local atmosphere. Book on summer evenings and weekends.

name: Xatheri
description: A quieter Kroustas favourite with fresh Cretan dishes and good vegetarian and vegan options. A short drive above Kritsa through olive groves.

name: Sto Steki (Mesa Lakkonia)
description: Village taverna in Mesa Lakonia with generous plates of traditional Cretan food at fair prices. Off the tourist track, a short drive from Agios Nikolaos.

name: Miliaras Tavern
description: Local taverna in Latsida, known for its meats and regional dishes in a simple village setting. Popular with locals on weekends.
address: Epar.Od. Latsidas - Agiou Antoniou, Latsida 724 00, Greece

name: Cafe - Tavern O Palemilos
description: Kafeneio-taverna in an old mill in Fourni, Mirabello, serving traditional Cretan cooking under the trees. Combine it with a visit to the nearby Kroustallenia or Areti monasteries.

name: Kato Kafeneia
description: Village kafeneio and meze spot in Limnes with an authentic local atmosphere and home-style plates. Inexpensive and genuine, near Neapoli.

name: Kivernitis Taverna
description: Family taverna in Vrachasi with views towards Mirabello Bay and classic Cretan dishes. Ask for a terrace table at sunset.

name: Taverna Anavlochos
description: Traditional Cretan cooking in the hill village of Vrachasi, with simple, well-priced home-style plates. A short detour off the national road near Neapoli.

name: Nick's Koutouki
description: Small koutouki in Milatos village with homely meze and raki in a cosy setting. Few tables, so arrive early in the evening.

name: En Milato
description: Traditional Cretan dishes in Milatos village, made with local produce and served in a relaxed setting. Pair it with a visit to the historic Milatos Cave.

name: Paradosiako Kafeneio Mezedopoleio Chalkias
description: Traditional kafeneio and meze house on Neapoli's Evangelistria square, with home-cooked casseroles and grills. Lively with locals in the evening.
address: Plateia Evangelistrias, Kapetan Koraka 0, Neapoli 724 00, Greece

name: Anatoli
description: Family taverna in Sisi with classic Cretan dishes and a warm welcome, a few steps from the harbour. Reliable for an easy dinner.

name: Neromilos
description: Restaurant in an old watermill above Sisi, with sea views and refined Cretan cooking. Book for a sunset table in summer.

name: Kafenes
description: Kafeneio in the hill village of Vrouchas above Plaka, serving meze and raki on a quiet square. A peaceful break from the busy coast.

name: Tis Malamatis
description: Homely taverna in Epano Elounda village with traditional home cooking and a friendly, family feel. A short drive up from Elounda harbour.

name: Kafeneio Nikos
description: Traditional kafeneio and meze spot in Kalo Chorio near Istron, serving raki with small Cretan plates. Inexpensive and local.

name: Portes
description: Cosy meze house in central Agios Nikolaos, a local favourite for traditional Cretan recipes and small plates. Book in summer, as tables fill quickly.

name: To Potiraki
description: Small raki-and-meze spot in Agios Nikolaos where every carafe comes with a round of small plates. Great for a relaxed evening with friends.
address: Pl. El. Venizélou 7-8, Ag. Nikolaos 721 00, Greece

name: Archontiko
description: Classic taverna near the Agios Nikolaos harbour with home-style cooked dishes such as stews and oven bakes. Good value and central.
address: Akti Papa Nikolaou Pagalou 2, Ag. Nikolaos 721 00, Greece

name: Gipas Kafenio
description: Taverna on the outskirts of Agios Nikolaos with grilled meats and local dishes, popular with Cretan families. Easier parking than in town.
address: Palaia EO Irakleioi - Agioi Nikolaoi 7, Xirokampos 721 00, Greece

name: Akrohoria
description: Hillside taverna above Agios Nikolaos with a panoramic view over Mirabello Bay and Cretan cooking. Come for sunset; book ahead in summer.

name: The Hope Mezestaurant – To Rakadiko tou Kamari
description: Seaside raki-and-meze house serving Cretan small plates right by the water in Mavrikiano near Agios Nikolaos. Lovely at sunset; reserve a waterfront table in summer.

name: Palio Kantouni
description: Traditional taverna in Elounda with sea-facing tables and well-cooked Cretan classics. Book on summer evenings.
address: N.Foka, Epar.Od. Agiou Nikolaou - Vrouchas, Mavrikiano 720 53, Greece

name: To Pefko (The Pine Tree)
description: Taverna in Plaka under a big pine tree, with views across to Spinalonga and simple Cretan dishes. Ideal before or after the boat to the island.
address: Epar.Od. Agiou Nikolaou - Vrouchas 52, Schisma Elountas 720 53, Greece

name: Kapilio
description: Ierapetra meze house, top-ranked locally, serving Cretan small plates with raki and wine. Book in high season, as it is small and popular.

name: Rakosyllektes
description: Raki house in Ierapetra where each round of raki arrives with a new set of meze. A fun, local evening out.

name: Stsi Koumbares
description: Seaside meze spot in Ierapetra with homemade dishes and tables by the water. Relaxed and good value.

name: Sti Gonia
description: Little corner spot in Ierapetra serving homemade meze in a casual, friendly setting. Popular with locals; arrive early.

name: Taverna Agia Paraskevi
description: Celebrated village taverna and raki house in Agia Paraskevi, inland from Ierapetra, praised by Athinorama for honest Cretan cooking. Worth the short drive; book on weekends.

name: Oasis
description: Taverna by the springs of Kalamafka, shaded by plane trees and with mountain views. A cool lunch stop on the mountain road between Ierapetra and the north coast.
address: Epar.Od. Kalou Choriou - Metaxochoriou 54, Kalamafka 722 00, Greece

name: Taverna O Giannakos
description: Award-listed mountain taverna in Kalamafka with home cooking and local meats. A short detour on the mountain road north of Ierapetra.

name: Drigies
description: Taverna in the mountain village of Anatoli with sweeping views and traditional dishes. The winding road up from Ierapetra takes about 25 minutes.

name: Prokopis
description: Meze taverna in the hill village of Vainia with views down to the Libyan Sea and home-style plates. Cool evenings in summer; a short drive from Ierapetra.

name: To Provarma
description: Mountain taverna in Thrypti, high above the south coast, with traditional dishes and panoramic views. Reached by a winding mountain road, so drive up in daylight.

name: Paradosiako Kafeneio Koutsounari
description: Traditional kafeneio in old Koutsounari village, with simple meze and views over the coast. A quiet alternative to the beach-side spots.

name: Taverna Nikos
description: Award-listed taverna in Koutsounari praised for authentic Cretan food at fair prices. Convenient for Ierapetra and the east-coast beaches.

name: Kalliotzina
description: Acclaimed Makrygialos taverna celebrated for herb-and-greens-led Cretan cooking with seasonal local produce. Book ahead in summer.

name: O Platanos
description: Taverna on the Myrtos village square under a big plane tree, with traditional dishes in a relaxed, shady setting. Close to the beach.

name: Dragon's Cave Tavern
description: Hillside restaurant in Lagada with Libyan Sea views and creative-traditional Cretan food. Book for sunset in high season.

name: Kathodon
description: Roadside taverna in Myrsini with a wide view over the Gulf of Mirabello and home-style Cretan cooking. A good stop on the road to Sitia.

name: Ntakos Cafe Restaurant
description: Village taverna in Kavousi with traditional dishes and a friendly welcome. Convenient after visiting the ancient olive tree of Azoria.

name: Taverna Natural
description: Taverna in the hill village of Lastros with sweeping views and Cretan cooking from local ingredients. Book a terrace table for sunset.

name: Olga's Greek Cuisine
description: Homely taverna in Mochlos where Olga cooks home-style Greek and Cretan dishes. Good value with a waterfront setting.

name: Mesostrati Paradosiako Kafeneio
description: Traditional kafeneio on the village square of Lithines in inland Sitia, with simple meze and coffee. A genuine stop on the road to Makrygialos.

name: Taverna – Rakadiko Outopia
description: Village taverna and raki house in Achladia with traditional Sitia cooking. A quiet, authentic stop inland from Sitia.

name: Aéroinon
description: Raki-and-meze tavern in Piskokefalo just outside Sitia, popular with locals for its generous plates. Easy parking.

name: Inodion
description: Taverna with views over Sitia and its bay, serving traditional dishes. Best enjoyed at sunset on the terrace.

name: Stin Ygeia Mas
description: Sitia meze-and-grill house with generous portions of grilled meats and Cretan small plates. Lively and good value.

name: Spitiko
description: Sitia spot for home-cooked dishes of the day, from stews to oven bakes. Come at lunchtime for the best choice.

name: Kafe Pontios (Kyriakos Apost. Triantafyllidis)
description: Kafeneio-taverna on the Zakros village square, serving coffee, meze and simple Cretan dishes. A good stop before hiking the Gorge of the Dead.

name: Adravasti Taverna - Yannis Mitsakakis
description: Taverna with a panoramic view over Kato Zakros and the Gorge of the Dead, serving Cretan food on a scenic terrace. Ideal before or after the gorge hike.
address: EPAR. ODOS Zirou, Kato Zakros 723 00, Greece

name: "Retro" family tavern
description: Family-run taverna in Palekastro with retro décor, fresh homemade Cretan dishes and good vegan options. Open evenings only, so check before going.

name: ELENA "mama" cuisine
description: Home-style cooking in Palekastro from Elena, with daily dishes and a welcoming family feel. Convenient for Kouremenos and Vai beaches.

name: Cafe Kalivas
description: Village kafeneio in Prina famed for its souvlaki and pork belly. Inexpensive and authentic, a short drive from Agios Nikolaos.

name: Kafeovelistirion tou Koutouzou to Koutouki
description: Village souvlaki kafeneio on the square of Vainia, serving grilled skewers and raki. Authentic and inexpensive.

name: Anamnesia Taverna
description: Seafront taverna right on Kato Zakros beach beside the Minoan palace, serving traditional Cretan dishes and fresh fish. Ideal for lunch after the Zakros Gorge hike or a swim in the cove.

name: Kohili Taverna
description: Fish taverna on the little harbour of Milatos, with fresh catch and sea views. Ideal for a quiet seaside lunch.

name: Psarogiali Fish &Grill
description: Fish market with a grill in Agios Nikolaos: pick your fish from the counter and have it cooked on the spot. Great value and very fresh.

name: Ofou to lo
description: Seaside fish taverna in Agios Nikolaos known for fresh catch and seafood meze with sea views. Book a table by the water.
address: Akti Papa Nikolaou Pagalou 1, Ag. Nikolaos 721 00, Greece

name: Gargadoros Tavern
description: Seafront fish restaurant in Agios Nikolaos with fresh daily catch and sea views. Ask what the boats brought in.

name: DESPINA ELOUNDA
description: Harbour-side fish taverna in Elounda serving fresh fish and seafood with views of the boats and bay. Book in July and August.

name: Nikos Fish Tavern
description: Traditional Elounda fish taverna with fresh fish sold by weight. Check the price per kilo before ordering.

name: Kanali
description: Fish restaurant beside the Elounda canal near the sunken city of Olous, with fresh seafood and lovely evening views. Reserve for sunset.

name: Spinalonga Restaurant
description: Fish taverna in Plaka facing Spinalonga island, with fresh fish and tables by the water. Perfect after the boat trip.

name: Vira Potzi
description: Seafood restaurant beside the Kales fortress in Ierapetra, serving fresh fish with harbour views. Book for sunset.

name: Levante (Nikolaos G. Fragkiadakis)
description: Fish taverna on the Ierapetra waterfront serving fresh fish alongside Cretan and Greek dishes. Relaxed and good value.

name: Ta Kochylia
description: Historic Mochlos fish taverna facing the Minoan islet, with fresh catch and tables by the sea. Book in summer.

name: Taverna To Bogazi
description: Mochlos fish taverna right on the water with views of the islet and fresh seafood. Book in summer.

name: Aposperítis
description: Sitia fish and meze spot by the sea, with fresh catch and small plates. A favourite with locals.

name: Tzivaeri
description: Sitia seafood meze house serving fresh fish and small plates. Cosy and good value.

name: Hiona Taverna
description: Legendary fish taverna on Chiona beach near Palekastro, serving fresh fish and seafood right on the sand. Book in summer.

name: Agistri
description: Fish taverna on Kato Zakros beach serving fresh fish beside the sea. Ideal after the Zakros Gorge hike.

name: Grandes Seaside Restaurant
description: Fish taverna on windy Kouremenos beach with fresh seafood and views of the windsurfers. Relaxed and family-friendly.

name: Fish Tavern Apostolos
description: Small fish taverna on the little harbour of Sissi, serving the day’s catch simply grilled. Ask what came in that morning.

name: Piato
description: Creative Greek cuisine in Agios Nikolaos, consistently praised by Greek food guides for modern takes on local produce. Book for dinner in summer.
address: Akti Iosif, Koundourou 8, Ag. Nikolaos 721 00, Greece

name: Migomis Piano Restaurant & Café
description: Elegant restaurant-café above Lake Voulismeni with modern Mediterranean cuisine and city views, also serving breakfast and coffee. Book a terrace table for sunset.
address: Nikolaou Plastira 20, Nik. Plastira 22, Ag. Nikolaos 721 00, Greece

name: Gioma Meze
description: Modern meze restaurant on the Agios Nikolaos seafront with creative small plates and sea views. Book in high season.

name: Almiriki
description: Contemporary Greek cuisine on the Akti Nearchou seafront, with sea views and a modern take on Cretan dishes. Good for a relaxed dinner.
address: Argyropoulon 2 &, Akti Nearchou, Ag. Nikolaos 721 00, Greece

name: Estia Bar & Kitchen
description: Contemporary kitchen and cocktail bar in Agios Nikolaos with modern plates and well-made drinks. Lively in the evening.

name: Ōkeanís
description: Creative Mediterranean dining in Elounda with a refined menu and bay views. Book ahead in summer.

name: Ergospasio Restaurant
description: Restaurant in a restored carob factory on the Elounda waterfront, serving modern Cretan and Mediterranean dishes by the sea. Book a waterside table for sunset.

name: FERRYMAN
description: Legendary waterside restaurant in Elounda known for seafood and Cretan dishes, with tables by the water. Book ahead in high season.

name: Lotus Eaters
description: Contemporary restaurant with sweeping views of Mirabello Bay near Elounda, serving modern Mediterranean cuisine. Booking recommended, especially for sunset.

name: Moon Spinners
description: Romantic restaurant with sunset views towards Spinalonga, serving refined Mediterranean dishes. Book for a sunset table.

name: Makris Elounda Fine Dining Restaurant by Domes
description: Fine-dining restaurant at Domes of Elounda, with a refined tasting menu and views over the bay. Booking essential; smart-casual dress.
address: Domes of Elounda, Tsifliki, Schisma Elountas 720 53, Greece

name: MamaLoukia & Lotzeta
description: Award-winning Cretan cuisine with a modern touch in Istron, using local seasonal produce. Book for dinner in summer.
address: EO Agiou Nikolaou - Sitias, Istro 721 00, Greece

name: Kalè Gastrobar
description: Harbour-side gastrobar in Ierapetra with creative plates and cocktails. Lively in the evening; good for sharing plates.

name: Pelagos Sea Side Restaurant
description: Seaside restaurant on Koutsounari beach with Mediterranean seafood dishes and sea views. Book a beachfront table at sunset.

name: Thalassa Seaside Restaurant & Lounge
description: Seaside restaurant and lounge near Ierapetra, with Mediterranean dishes and drinks by the water. Good for a long sunset dinner.

name: La Sera
description: Creative Mediterranean dining in Myrtos, with a seasonal menu and relaxed village atmosphere. Book in summer.

name: Basilico
description: Mediterranean restaurant in Sitia with well-crafted dishes and friendly service. A reliable choice for dinner in town.

name: Liviko View Restaurant
description: Restaurant overlooking the Libyan Sea at Xerokampos, serving Cretan and Mediterranean dishes with a sweeping view. Remote, so plan the winding drive in daylight.

name: Sochoro Greek Cuisine
description: Modern Cretan cooking in the small fishing village of Mochlos, with creative dishes based on local produce and friendly service. Book ahead for dinner in summer.

name: Ocean Restaurant
description: Restaurant in Plaka with views across to Spinalonga, known for its seafood and risotto. Book a table for sunset in high season.
address: Epar.Od. Agiou Nikolaou - Vrouchas, Plaka 720 53, Greece

name: No Name Restaurant & Bar
description: Relaxed seafront restaurant and bar right on Milatos beach, good for a long lunch by the water or a drink after a swim. Combine it with a visit to the nearby Milatos Cave.
address: Paralia, Paraliaki Odos Milatou, Milatos 724 00, Greece

name: Karnagio / Pita tou Riga
description: Legendary pita-gyros joint and taverna in Agios Nikolaos, famous for its pita gyros and souvlaki. Expect queues in summer; service is fast.

name: Tylixto Grill & Pita Stories
description: Modern grill and pita bar in Agios Nikolaos with quality wraps and grilled meats. Quick and good value.
address: Pl. El. Venizélou, Ag. Nikolaos 721 00, Greece

name: FAST GRILL
description: Grill house in Agios Nikolaos with quality meats and fast service. Ideal for a quick, cheap meal.

name: Spitiko - Grill Restaurant
description: Classic Lasithi-style souvlaki shop in Agios Nikolaos, popular with locals. Cheap and quick; takeaway available.

name: Sirocco
description: Craft pizza and art space on the Akti Nearchou seafront, with sea views and creative toppings. Relaxed and good value.

name: Praktoreio
description: Traditional family souvlaki shop in Elounda, with classic pita gyros and grills. Quick, cheap and popular.

name: Coha Grill House
description: Grill house in Elounda known for great sandwiches and grilled meats. Quick and good value.

name: Valeria Pizza&Pasta
description: Italian-run pizzeria in Istron with authentic thin-crust pizzas and pasta. Good for a relaxed family dinner.

name: Stam Stam Gyros
description: Gyros joint in Sisi, serving pita gyros and souvlaki. Quick and cheap near the harbour.

name: Valentino
description: Gyros spot in Tzermiado on the Lasithi Plateau, good for a quick, cheap lunch. Handy on a plateau drive.

name: O Gyros tou Kosmou
description: Award-listed gyros shop in Ierapetra with excellent pita gyros. Quick, cheap and popular with locals.

name: IL Gusto Pizza
description: Ierapetra pizzeria known for its big pizzas. Good for families; takeaway available.

name: Cantina barbeque
description: Seaside canteen in Pachia Ammos grilling meats over real charcoal. Quick, cheap and right by the beach.

name: Kantina Maria!
description: Award-listed roadside canteen in Koutsounari, serving grilled meats and sandwiches. Quick and cheap on the coastal road.
address: Epar.Od. Ierapetras – Siteias, Koutsounari, Ag. Ioannis 722 00, Greece

name: Berena Burgers
description: Burger house in Makrygialos with juicy burgers and fries. Quick and good value.

name: Kalagas
description: Village souvlaki spot in Kavousi, serving grilled skewers and pita. Cheap and authentic.

name: Choiropiastó
description: Grill house in Palekastro with grilled meats and souvlaki. Quick and inexpensive.

name: Kastrí
description: Old-school pizzeria near Palekastro with traditional pizzas. Good for families after a beach day.
address: EPAR. ODOS PALAIKASTROU VAI 345, Palekastro 723 00, Greece

name: P.al.m.os
description: Authentic pizza and coffee in Sitia, with good pizzas and quick service. Inexpensive and central.

name: Kimzu sea Lounge
description: A sea lounge on the rocks south of the marina with sunbeds, sea access and cocktails into the evening; one of the town’s favourite sunset spots. Open seasonally, roughly May to October; book a sunbed or table in August.

name: Amoodi
description: A boho beach bar in a palm-lined cove 1 km from the centre, with wooden paths to the sand, creative cocktails and a chilled soundtrack. Open seasonally, roughly May to October; book a sunbed or table in August.

name: Achinos
description: Feet-in-the-sand dining and drinks on Ammoudi beach: seafood plates, salads and cocktails with sunbed service. Open seasonally, roughly May to October; book a sunbed or table in August.
address: Epar.Od. Agiou Nikolaou - Vrouchas 6, Ag. Nikolaos 721 00, Greece

name: Macrame by Voulisma
description: A stylish beach club and seafood restaurant on Voulisma (Golden Beach), with sunbeds on the sand and cocktails by the turquoise bay. Open seasonally, roughly May to October; book a sunbed or table in August.

name: Isla - bistrot & cocktail bar
description: All-day bistro and cocktail bar on Plaka beach looking straight at Spinalonga — breakfast, light lunch and sunset cocktails. Open seasonally, roughly May to October; book a sunbed or table in August.

name: ARPON
description: The only café-bar on secluded Tholos beach: tasty food, cocktails and a relaxed, family-friendly setting by the water. Open seasonally, roughly May to October; book a sunbed or table in August.

name: Kalamia all day beach bar
description: A friendly beach bar on Sitia’s main sandy beach with sunbeds, good coffee, snacks and cocktails. Open seasonally, roughly May to October; book a sunbed or table in August.

name: Ageras All Day Beach Bar
description: All-day beach bar at the quieter eastern end of Sitia’s beach, with sunbeds, coffee and light bites. Open seasonally, roughly May to October; book a sunbed or table in August.

name: Glaros Beach Bar
description: The beach bar-taverna of windy Kouremenos: lunch, cold drinks and a front-row view of the windsurfers. Open seasonally, roughly May to October; book a sunbed or table in August.

name: Surf Beach - Snack Bar Kouremenos
description: Laid-back snack bar beside the windsurf centre at Kouremenos — burgers, salads and smoothies with sand underfoot. Open seasonally, roughly May to October; book a sunbed or table in August.

name: Big Blue Beach Bar
description: A relaxed beach bar in Koutsouras for every hour of the day — morning coffee, ice cream, snacks and sunset cocktails, without the noise. Open seasonally, roughly May to October; book a sunbed or table in August.

name: Coukos Island
description: Seafront café and beach bar in Makrygialos for brunch, coffee and cocktails with the sea a few steps away. Open seasonally, roughly May to October.

name: Melydron Cafe Beach Bar
description: Beach bar by Makrygialos’ little harbour, known for good lunches and a long happy hour on cocktails in the early evening. Open seasonally, roughly May to October; book a sunbed or table in August.

name: Cavo Bianco
description: A white-washed beach club on Diaskari beach with comfortable sunbeds, a pool-party vibe at weekends and food all day. Open seasonally, roughly May to October; book a sunbed or table in August.

name: Galini Tavern
description: Beach taverna-bar right on Achlia’s calm bay — sunbeds, fresh fish and Greek dishes, cold drinks. Open seasonally, roughly May to October; book a sunbed or table in August.

name: Nalu a Paraiso Concept - Beach, Pool
description: A boutique beach-and-pool bar at Kakkos Bay near Ierapetra: calm sunbeds, local-product dishes, signature cocktails and a good Cretan wine list. Open seasonally, roughly May to October; book a sunbed or table in August.

name: Waikiki Coffee House
description: Ierapetra’s classic beach bar on the town beach: sunbeds with a drink, burgers and ice cream, a kids’ playground and a lively evening scene. Open all year, with shorter hours in winter.

name: Avra (Myrtos)
description: A small, friendly beach café at the quiet end of Myrtos’ promenade, with umbrellas and sunbeds on the beach. Open seasonally, roughly May to October; book a sunbed or table in August.

name: Je m'en fous mirtos
description: The village’s favourite seafront café-bar, run by a welcoming couple — great cocktails and a buzzing atmosphere after the beach. Open seasonally, roughly May to October; book a sunbed or table in August.

name: Bajamar - Cocktail Bar
description: Agios Nikolaos’ best-loved cocktail bar on the harbour: inventive, well-priced cocktails, good music and late hours. Open all year; busiest from June to September.

name: Alexandros Roof Cocktail Bar
description: A leafy rooftop cocktail bar above the lake with DJ music and a party mood late into the night. Open seasonally, roughly April/May to October.

name: Arodo Cafe Bar
description: A loft cocktail bar with a harbour-view balcony, known for creative drinks and a relaxed rooftop mood for stargazing. Open all year; busiest from June to September.

name: Yanni's Rock Bar
description: A legendary little rock bar on the harbour — classic rock, requests welcome and a loyal crowd until the early hours. Open all year; busiest from June to September.

name: Rob's Corner
description: A welcoming Irish pub run by a friendly couple, with sports on screen and lively karaoke nights. Open all year; busiest from June to September.
address: Mich. Sfakianaki 7, M, Ag. Nikolaos 721 00, Greece

name: Babel Cocktail Bar Restaurant
description: A buzzing cocktail bar-restaurant on Elounda’s waterfront, good for dinner that turns into drinks. Open seasonally, roughly April/May to October.

name: Eden Cocktail Bar
description: A large garden lounge on Elounda’s main square opposite the harbour — cocktails under the stars. Open seasonally, roughly April/May to October.
address: Pl. Sfakianaki Mpoti, Schisma Elountas 720 53, Greece

name: BEERaki Cretan Pub
description: A Cretan craft-beer and cocktail pub in the hillside village of Mavrikiano above Elounda, with local brews and raki-based drinks. Open seasonally, roughly April/May to October.

name: Friends Bar
description: Istron’s friendly cocktail bar — carefully made drinks, free snacks and a cosy atmosphere. Open seasonally, roughly April/May to October.

name: Queens lounge
description: Sunset cocktails and food overlooking the pretty fishing harbour of Sisi. Open seasonally, roughly April/May to October.

name: Cactus Pub
description: The lively pub of Sisi village, with sports on screen, music and a friendly mixed crowd. Open seasonally, roughly April/May to October.

name: Caravan Cocktail Open Bar
description: An open-air cocktail bar on Ierapetra’s nightlife street (Kyrva), with music and a lively late-night scene. Open seasonally, roughly April/May to October.

name: The Wall Music Bar
description: Sitia’s go-to music bar on the harbour promenade — great cocktails, good playlists and tables by the water. Open all year; busiest from June to September.

name: Olympio Cafe
description: The main evening hangout of Makrygialos, by the little harbour — cocktails, music and a sociable crowd. Open seasonally, roughly April/May to October.

name: Green Bar
description: A summer beachfront bar at Analipsi: sunbeds and food by day, drinks with good music by night. Open seasonally, roughly April/May to October.

name: Bar Raki
description: A small, characterful waterfront bar in Mochlos for raki, cocktails and a slow evening by the sea. Open seasonally, roughly April/May to October.

name: Isalos Elounda
description: A romantic seafront cocktail bar on Elounda’s Olous waterfront: tables by the water, well-made cocktails and a calm, lantern-lit mood at night. Open seasonally, roughly May to October.

name: The Rock‘s
description: A tiny bar on the rocks of Mochlos harbour facing the Minoan islet — swim, sip and stay for the sunset. Open seasonally, roughly May to October.

name: Kermen Seaside Experience
description: An upscale seaside lounge 50 m from Ierapetra’s Kales fortress — specialty coffee, cocktails and comfortable seating by the water. Open seasonally, roughly May to October.

name: Toplou Fabrica
description: Tasting room of the historic Toplou Monastery estate, pouring organic wines, tsikoudia and olive oil next to the 15th-century monastery. Open April–October, daily 10:00–17:00; booking recommended on +30 28430 29636.

name: Petrakis Wines
description: A family micro-winery in Mouliana — the home of the Liatiko grape — offering guided tours and tastings of its small-batch wines. Phone ahead to confirm before you visit.
address: Mesa Mouliana Katsabas, Mesa Mouliana 720 57, Greece

name: Vassilakis Estate - Wine Tasting Crete
description: Wine tasting at the Vassilakis family estate near Neapoli, combinable with their popular olive-oil mill tour. Open Monday–Saturday 09:00–17:00; booking recommended for groups.

name: Spinalonga Fortress
description: The Venetian sea fortress that became Europe’s last leper colony (until 1957), made famous by Victoria Hislop’s “The Island”. Reach it by short boat ride from Plaka or Elounda.

name: Archaeological Museum of Agios Nikolaos
description: Recently renovated museum of eastern Crete, home to the Minoan “Goddess of Myrtos” jug and finds from across Lasithi. Closed on Tuesdays; allow about an hour.

name: Church of Panagia Kera
description: A 13th–14th-century Byzantine church with some of the finest frescoes on Crete, just below Kritsa village. Closed on Tuesdays; small entrance fee and modest dress.

name: Ancient City of Lato
description: Dorian hill-city of the 7th century BC between two peaks, with an agora, theatre steps and sweeping views to Mirabello Bay. Closed on Tuesdays; there is little shade, so bring water and a hat.

name: Rodanthi Museum
description: A small, lovingly run museum and shop in Kritsa devoted to Cretan herbs, their history and traditional uses. Allow 30 minutes and browse the herb shop on your way out.

name: Archaeological Site of Gournia
description: The best-preserved Minoan town in Crete: walk its narrow stone streets, houses and small palace above Mirabello Bay. Closed on Tuesdays; there is little shade, so visit early or late in the day.

name: Holy Monastery of Panagia Faneromeni of Ierapetra
description: A monastery built into the cliff above Gournia with a cave chapel and one of the most impressive views over the Gulf of Mirabello. Reached by a narrow winding road above Gournia; modest dress is required.

name: Milatos Cave
description: A cave above Milatos where villagers sheltered during the 1823 Ottoman siege; a chapel and memorial stand at the entrance. Bring a torch for the cave interior.
address: Path to Milatos Cave, Ag. Nikolaos 724 00, Greece

name: Cave of Diktaion Andron
description: The mythical birthplace of Zeus, a dramatic cave with stalactites reached by a steep path above Psychro on the Lasithi Plateau. Closed on Tuesdays; the steep path up takes about 15 minutes, or you can ride a donkey.

name: Iera Moni Koimiseos Theotokou Krustallenias
description: A peaceful monastery on a pine-covered hill with a beautiful view over the Lasithi Plateau. Modest dress is required; the access road is paved but narrow.

name: Monastery of the Mother Mary Vidiani
description: A quiet 19th-century monastery on the edge of the plateau with a small ecological/history museum. Modest dress is required; a short detour on the plateau ring road.

name: Folklore Museum of Agios Georgios
description: A traditional plateau house preserved with its furniture, tools and loom — a window into old mountain life. A short, easy stop on a Lasithi Plateau drive.

name: Venetian Fort Kales
description: The small Venetian fortress guarding Ierapetra’s old harbour, lovely at sunset with the seafront cafés next door. Closed on Tuesdays.

name: Holy Monastery of Kapsa
description: A monastery wedged into the cliff at the mouth of Pervolakia gorge, right above the Libyan Sea. Modest dress is required; the coastal road east of Makrygialos leads right to it.

name: Toplou Monastery
description: A fortified 15th-century monastery famous for its icon “Lord, Thou Art Great”, with a museum and its own organic wine and olive oil. A ticket is needed for the museum; modest dress is required.

name: Ancient City Itanos
description: Ruins of an ancient port city at the north-east tip of Crete, right above the turquoise coves of Erimoupolis. Free, with parking by the site; combine it with a swim at the Erimoupolis coves.

name: Minoan Palace of Zakros
description: One of the four great Minoan palaces, set by the beach of Kato Zakros at the end of the Gorge of the Dead. Combine it with the Zakros Gorge hike and a swim at Kato Zakros.

name: Archaeological Museum of Sitia
description: Finds from eastern Crete’s Minoan sites, including the ivory “Palaikastro Kouros”. Closed on Tuesdays.

name: Folklore Museum
description: A charming museum of traditional weaving, embroidery and household life in eastern Crete. Allow 30–45 minutes in the Sitia old town.

name: Plaka Beach
description: Crystal-clear water over white pebbles, right opposite Spinalonga island; great snorkelling (turtles are often seen). Afternoon breeze is common, and boats to Spinalonga leave from the village.

name: Kolokytha Beach
description: A turquoise, sheltered cove on the Spinalonga peninsula, reached by a short dirt track and walk — one of the best snorkelling spots in the Elounda area. Bring water, shade and water shoes.
address: Kolokytha Beach, Kalydon Peninsula, Schisma Eloundas 720 53, Greece

name: Beach Almyros
description: The best sandy beach within walking distance of Agios Nikolaos, with shallow water, a small wetland and cool freshwater springs at the western end. Access: asphalt road, 2 km S of Agios Nikolaos town; walkable from town.

name: Paralia Ammoudara
description: A long, easy sandy beach just south of Agios Nikolaos with shallow water and sunbeds — a calm family choice. Access: asphalt (Agios Nikolaos–Ierapetra road), 4 km S of town; bus.

name: Voulisma beach
description: Lasithi’s famous "Golden Beach": fine golden sand and remarkably turquoise, shallow water in a sheltered bay; snorkel along the rocks at either end. Arrive early in high season.

name: Paralia Tholos
description: A quiet, sheltered cove below Kavousi with clear water and rocks for snorkelling, plus a beach café for lunch — a hidden gem of Mirabello Bay. Access: paved side road from Kavousi (last stretch narrow).

name: Mochlos Beach
description: A pebbly village beach in picturesque Mochlos, facing the Minoan islet 150 m offshore; swim with a mask along the rocks, then eat at the waterfront fish tavernas. Access: asphalt road down to the fishing village.

name: Sitia Beach
description: A long, gently shelving sandy beach right on Sitia’s seafront, with sunbeds, beach bars and calm water — easy for families. Access: in town, 3 km sandy strip along the bay.

name: Vai Beach
description: The iconic palm-fringed beach backed by Europe’s largest natural palm forest (Phoenix theophrasti). Come early to beat the tour buses; the small viewpoint path south of the beach gives the classic photo.
address: Epar.Od. Monis Toplous - Vai, Toplou 723 00, Greece

name: Erimoupolis beach
description: Several unspoilt sandy coves next to the ruins of ancient Itanos, with very clear water and rocky edges for snorkelling. No facilities — bring water and shade.

name: Kouremenos beach
description: Crete’s windsurf and wingfoil hotspot, thanks to steady north winds; on calm days a long, relaxed beach with tamarisks and two beach bars. Access: asphalt road 2 km from Palekastro.

name: Paralia Chiona
description: A quiet beach near Palekastro with clear water and fish tavernas on the shore, next to the Minoan town of Roussolakkos; good snorkelling at the rocky ends. Access: asphalt road 2 km E of Palekastro.

name: Karoumes Beach
description: A completely wild bay reached only by a one-hour hike through the Chochlakies gorge — turquoise water and total seclusion. Bring plenty of water and sturdy shoes.

name: Kato Zakros beach
description: A remote pebble bay at the end of the Gorge of the Dead, beside the Minoan Palace of Zakros, with a handful of tavernas on the sand — perfect after the gorge hike. Access: asphalt road (winding) from Zakros; or hike down the Gorge of the Dead.

name: Mazida Ammos beach
description: Xerokambos’ best beach: a long sweep of white sand and shallow, turquoise water, sheltered from the north winds. Very remote, so bring supplies.

name: Karavopetra Beach (Xerokambos)
description: A small sandy cove with sculpted rocks at the north end of Xerokambos — quiet, shallow and lovely for a swim with a mask. Access: short dirt track off the Xerokambos road.

name: Makrygialos Beach
description: One of the most family-friendly beaches on the south coast: fine sand and very shallow, calm water with beach bars and tavernas along the bay. Access: in the village, asphalt road.

name: Diaskari beach
description: A wide sandy beach just east of Makrygialos with shallow water and a stylish beach club, usually sheltered from the north winds. Access: asphalt road, 2 km E of Makrygialos.

name: Mavros Kolymbos Beach
description: A small sandy cove framed by dark rocks just off the coastal road, with deep-blue water and good snorkelling. Access: directly off the Ierapetra–Sitia road (steps down).

name: Achlia Beach
description: A small, calm bay with soft sand and clear water, plus a beach taverna-bar for lunch — a relaxed stop between Ierapetra and Makrygialos. Access: short paved road down from the main road.

name: Agia Fotia Beach
description: A picturesque cove at the mouth of a small gorge, with tamarisks for shade, a chapel and very clear water — considered one of Lasithi’s prettiest beaches. Access: steep paved road down from the coastal road; limited parking.
address: Agia Fotia Beach, Agia Fotia, Ierapetra 722 00, Greece

name: Koutsounari Long Beach
description: A 2.5 km beach east of Ierapetra with tamarisk shade, shallow water and plenty of space — organized in parts, free and quiet elsewhere. Access: asphalt road, 6 km E of Ierapetra.

name: Paralia Mirtos
description: The laid-back village beach of Myrtos, with clear Libyan Sea water, sunbeds in front of cafés and tavernas, and an easy-going, bohemian vibe. Access: in Myrtos village, asphalt road 15 km W of Ierapetra.

name: Chrysi
description: A protected desert island 8 miles off Ierapetra, with turquoise lagoon-like water, juniper-cedar forest and golden beaches. Go by day boat (May–October); bring water and sun protection, and do not take shells or sand.

name: Golden Beach
description: Chrysi’s signature "Golden Beach" on the south side: soft golden sand, shallow turquoise water and cedar-covered dunes, a short walk from the boat landing. Access: boat to Chrysi, then ~15 min walk across the island from Vougiou Mati.
address: Golden Beach (Belegrina), Chrysi Island, Ierapetra 722 00, Greece

name: Pelagos Dive Centre
description: Agios Nikolaos’ PADI 5-Star dive resort at the Minos Beach Art Hotel: gentle house-reef try-dives for first-timers and boat dives to reefs and walls of Mirabello Bay for certified divers. Season Apr–Nov; book ahead in July and August.
address: Minos Beach Hotel, Epar.Od. Agiou Nikolaou - Vrouchas, Ag. Nikolaos 721 00, Greece

name: Mediterranean View Diving Center (MVD)
description: Friendly PADI centre at Candia Park Village, rated #1 activity in Agios Nikolaos on TripAdvisor: calm, warm water and a training pool make it perfect for a first dive or a full Open Water course. Season Apr–Nov; book ahead in July and August.
address: Candia Park Village Hotel, Ag. Nikolaos 721 00, Greece

name: AMOUDI WATERSPORTS
description: Family-run since 1985 on Ammoudi beach, just north of town: water-skiing and wakeboarding lessons, jet skis, tube rides and SUPs with clear safety briefings and well-kept kit. Season May–Oct; book ahead in July and August.
address: Epar.Od. Agiou Nikolaou - Vrouchas 6, Ag. Nikolaos 721 00, Greece

name: Diving Center Blue Dolphin Elounda
description: One of Crete’s longest-running dive bases, at the Aquila Elounda Village: patient instructors, Discover Scuba and snorkelling sessions ideal for beginners and families, plus guided dives around Elounda bay. Season Apr–Oct; book ahead in July and August.
address: Aquila Elounda Village Hotel, Schisma Eloundas 720 53, Greece

name: PETROS Water sports & Boat Rental
description: Elounda’s water-ski and wakeboard specialists on the sheltered bay north of the village, also renting kayaks, SUPs and windsurf boards – flat morning water is ideal for beginners. Season May–Oct; book ahead in July and August.
address: Epar.Od. Agiou Nikolaou - Vrouchas 52, Schisma Elountas 720 53, Greece

name: Ierapetra Watersports (Petra Mare)
description: The go-to beach watersports centre in Ierapetra, next to the Petra Mare hotel: jet skis with satellite safety tracking, water-skiing, wakeboarding, tube rides and SUPs. Season May–Oct; book ahead in July and August.

name: NICEDIVE4U PADI 5 Star Dive Center Crete
description: Small family-run PADI 5-Star centre in Sitia (Michaela & Thomas) – relaxed, unhurried courses, a nearby wreck and night dives in one of Crete’s least crowded corners. Freediving courses too.

name: Gone Surfing Crete Windsurfing & Wingfoiling Center
description: Boutique, owner-run windsurf and wingfoil centre (Christos & Maria) on Kouremenos – one of Europe’s windiest flat-water bays. Beginner-friendly inner bay, top Duotone gear and constant baywatch.
address: Plakopoules Area, Kouremenos - Plakopoules Road, Palekastro 723 00, Greece

name: Freak Surf Crete
description: Long-established windsurf station in the middle of sandy Kouremenos bay, with JP/NP gear, a shady, sociable base and an enclosed bay so you can’t drift offshore. Vai palm beach is 10 minutes away.

name: Amazonas Animal Park
description: A large hillside wildlife park near Neapoli with lemurs, macaws, macaques and other animals in wooded enclosures, plus scheduled feeding sessions. Plan 2–3 hours; the lemur feeding is the highlight for kids.
address: Way to kourounes, Eparchiaki odos Kourounon, Neapoli 724 00, Greece

name: Greek Mythology Thematic Park
description: A beautifully kept open-air park of mythology and Minoan-themed sculptures beside the Dikteon Cave at Psychro, with statues and scenes kids love to explore. Combine it with the cave visit; it may close in bad weather, so check before you go.

name: Spiridi Olive Oil Farm
description: Hands-on Cretan farm experience just outside Agios Nikolaos: olive-oil tour, pottery, cheese-making and cooking workshops that work well with children. Book workshops ahead in high season.
address: Cretan Olive Oil Farm, Ag. Nikolaos 721 00, Greece

name: Sissi Mini Golf
description: A large seaside mini-golf course in Sissi with a kids’ play area, pool tables and a café-bar. An easy family evening out; open seasonally.

name: Ierapetra Go Kart
description: Go-kart track at Stenakas just outside Ierapetra, with karts for kids as well as adults and a friendly family feel. Expect queues on summer evenings.

name: Minos Park
description: A leafy town park with a café in Ierapetra, with plenty of open space for kids to run around and simple food for parents. A handy break when you are in town with children.

name: Playground 5×5
description: The main indoor/outdoor play centre in Agios Nikolaos, with inflatables for different ages and tables for parents. The practical rainy-day option in town; service can be slow when it is busy.
